grounded.observation: Current host snapshots and visibility-filtered objects; integer tiles; six inventory slots.
grounded.structure_alive: For structures objectAlive means exposed; positive HP means standing.

predicates.candidate_exists: The current scan selected an observed attackable enemy.
predicates.inventory_has_empty: An empty slot was seen during the earlier inventory scan.
predicates.no_candidate: No candidate was observed; no assertion about unseen enemies.

situation.notes: Hosted replay evidence uses published game 2026.9.10.3. Hidden state reconstructed for offline diagnosis is not available to the policy.

grounded.lifetime: BASIC globals start at zero per episode and persist across decisions and respawns. join_wave revalidates an escort by observed living ID whenever selected.
grounded.uncertainty: Unseen enemies are unobserved. Tower targets and enemy intentions are not exposed.

B_equipment.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence; not evidence for this new candidate. Removing poison purchases may improve persistent equipment growth. The sustain-only center configuration failed its local validation (112/240 wins versus baseline 115/240); equipment growth alone has not demonstrated better fort wins. This targeting revision must be evaluated separately.

B_duel.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence; not evidence for this new candidate. Hero kills grant 150 XP and 100 gold, versus 25 XP and 15 gold for footmen. A distance-weighted hero preference may accelerate growth and reduce enemy pressure; it can also cause dangerous pursuit.

B_local_gate.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence; not evidence for this new candidate. Frozen BASIC 7247acb6fe63d5f0eb40dd21efe8e27263af06705bb7161faba362cc3d0e13f3 failed_local_gate: 123/240 candidate wins versus 100/240 matched baseline wins, across 24 independent seeds with all ten seats tested separately. Paired gain +0.0958; seed sign-test p=0.179642, alpha=0.025, required gain=0.1. This measures the complete configuration among nine default policies. It does not isolate individual changes or establish wider-field strength.

B_stalemate.claim: Ancestor Duelist evidence; not evidence for this new candidate. Post hoc validation diagnosis: 18/40 candidate wins versus 0/40 baseline wins occurred on four seeds whose baseline control timed out. On the other seeds the candidate won 105/200 versus 100/200. Most observed gain came from games that baseline failed to finish; stronger hero dueling or equipment growth is not established as the cause. This split does not change the failed local superiority gate.

B_structure.claim: Hero preference can divert attention from nearby exposed objectives. Equal structure priority may convert pressure into fort wins, but can increase tower exposure.

B_study_result.claim: Local discovery, six independent seed clusters with all ten seats: 25/60 wins versus matched Duelist 35/60. Predeclared activation proxy: {"candidate_rate": 0.0728352161579232, "control_rate": 0.0446383256050015, "observed": true}. Discovery is exploratory and cannot establish superiority. This candidate did not qualify for the single fresh-seed confirmation. No hosted field superiority follows from these local games.

G_fort.preference: Team fort victory is the terminal evaluation objective. Timeouts score zero.

G_base.preference: Maintain baseline decision accounting; combat, economy, and fallback objectives are specified by their own rules.

G_capacity.preference: Keep baseline healing and mana support while preserving gold for persistent equipment growth by omitting poison purchases.

G_center.preference: Return to the baseline central destination when no eligible enemy is observed.

G_duel.preference: Prefer nearby enemy heroes over footmen to gain the larger hero kill rewards and remove enemy damage. Distance still bounds the preference.

G_structure.preference: Set exposed-structure distance weight to 1, equal to heroes, while footmen retain weight 4.
